# Template Landing Page

## Default Sections
- Hero, proof, pain->solution, benefits, process, testimonials, CTA, FAQ, footer.

## Default Stack
- Next.js + Tailwind + optional motion library.

## KPI Focus
- CTA clarity, trust signals, mobile conversion.
